usage: jbus view-shot [-h] --out OUT [--width {1440,390}] [--home HOME]
                      [--port PORT]
                      route

positional arguments:
  route               the page's route, as '#/' or '#/<project>'

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
  --out OUT           the PNG to write, a bare name in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR or
                      /tmp
  --width {1440,390}
  --home HOME         the home the page shows, as <project>/<home> or a home
                      of this project
  --port PORT         the port of jbus view, its own by default
